title: Sigil Charging
summary: A chaos magick working. Your intent is reduced to a sigil, charged through breath and focus, then released and forgotten.
tradition: Chaos magick, after Austin Osman Spare
source: Letter reduction after Spare's The Book of Pleasure (1913). Ritual structure original to Virtual Rites.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Your intent: {intent}. Hold it once, clearly. Then let the words go. Only the sigil will remain.
steps.say: Arrive. Hold your intent once, clearly. Then let the words go.

steps.title: Settle the breath
steps.text: Breathe with the ring of light. In as it widens, out as it narrows.
steps.describe: A pale ring on the ground slowly widens and narrows with your breath.

steps.title: Cast the circle
steps.text: Turn slowly sunwise, drawing a ring of violet fire all the way around you.
steps.describe: A violet line of fire is drawn in a full ring around you at chest height.

steps.title: The sigil appears
steps.text: Your intent, reduced to {letters}, draws itself before you. Follow every line with your eyes.
steps.describe: A glowing magenta glyph draws itself in the air in front of you.

steps.title: Breathe into it
steps.text: In for four, out for four. With each breath the sigil burns brighter.
steps.describe: The glyph brightens steadily with each breath.

steps.title: Gnosis
steps.text: Hold the breath. Stare into the sigil. Empty the mind until nothing remains but the glyph.
steps.describe: The glyph spins faster and its halo swells as the light around you turns rose.

steps.title: Release
steps.text: Exhale sharply. The sigil flares and is gone, flung into the deep mind.
steps.describe: The glyph bursts into sparks and vanishes.

steps.title: Banish with laughter
steps.text: Laugh, out loud if you can. Forget the sigil. Forget the desire.

steps.title: The working is done
steps.text: Let it go. In your journal, note only what you felt, not what you wished for.
